ValidationRule.description: (Deprecated PD-270) This rule will validate that the sum of the "Net to Customer" field and the "Existing Loan Balance" is equal to Actual Amount Offered.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( Lender_Account__c = "0018000000nfIJI", Lender_Account__c = "0018000000whwPY", Lender_Account__c = "00180000011jo4A", Lender_Account__c = "0018000001HXhIz"), RecordTypeId="01280000000BZwl", ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Funded"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "RENEWAL"), BLANKVALUE(Current_Balance__c, 0) + BLANKVALUE(Net_to_Customer__c, 0) <> BLANKVALUE(ACTUAL_AMT_OFFERED__c, 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The sum of the fields "Net to Customer" and "Existing Loan Balance" does not equal the field "Actual Amount Offered"
